Description: Solar power generation depends on sunlight, leading to fluctuations in power supply.
Potential Solution: Use battery storage, demand response, and hybrid energy systems.

Description: Excess solar energy fed back into the grid can overload transformers and cause instability.
Potential Solution: Implement smart grid technology and dynamic voltage control.

Description: Poor-quality inverters introduce harmonic distortions, affecting power quality.
Potential Solution: Use high-quality inverters with harmonic filtering.

Impact: Lack of Inertia and Frequency Instability
Description: Unlike traditional generators, solar PV does not provide rotational inertia, making frequency regulation difficult.
Potential Solution: Deploy grid-forming inverters, battery storage, and flexible power plants.

Description: Sudden changes in solar generation can lead to voltage instability in the grid.
Potential Solution: Utilize advanced power electronics and voltage regulation techniques.
